title: La Dama de Compañía, MEXI STORIES
comment: dama-lagos (MEXI): comedor de una casa grande de hacienda en Lagos de Moreno, Jalisco. Caras comunes, no famosas; las tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.BENIGNA_ALTAMIRANO: Mexican woman, feared matriarch of a cattle hacienda, 76 years old, fair wrinkled skin, silver-white hair pulled back in a tight low bun, sharp pale-brown eyes, thin lips, a high-necked long-sleeve black dress, a small gold brooch at the collar, pearl earrings, her hands empty.
chars.PAULINA_ALTAMIRANO: Mexican woman, spoiled rich granddaughter of the hacienda, 26 years old, light skin, long straight light-brown hair with honey highlights, perfectly done makeup, nude lipstick, a cream silk long-sleeve blouse, tailored camel trousers, gold hoop earrings, her hands empty.
chars.MACRINA_LEAL: Mexican woman from a small town, bold and proud, 23 years old, warm brown skin, thick black hair in one long braid over her shoulder, strong dark eyebrows, intense dark eyes, no makeup, a white cotton blouse with red embroidered flowers, a long plain dark-blue skirt, simple leather sandals, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_COMEDORLAGOS: Large old dining room of a colonial hacienda house in Lagos de Moreno, Jalisco, in the morning: a long dark wooden table with a white embroidered tablecloth, porcelain plates, a silver coffee pot and a basket of sweet bread, heavy carved wooden chairs, thick white walls, tall wooden doors open to an arched corridor with plants, warm sunlight through tall windows, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
